name: read_cayley
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,re
p=Path.cwd();r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/cayley.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/cayley.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
s=r.stdout;print(s[:11500])
for m in re.finditer('Conjecture',s):print(s[max(0,m.start()-1000):m.start()+2000])
print('PAGES',len(s.split('\f')))
